privacy: Writing Kids is designed to minimize personal data. Core lessons and progress are stored on the device. Optional Firebase services may use an anonymous identifier and a push token when notifications are enabled. Payment details are submitted only for payment processing and should never be stored by the app. We do not intentionally collect children's names, photos, contacts, location, or advertising identifiers for core learning. Parents should review the app-store privacy labels and the payment provider's privacy notice before use.
terms: Writing Kids is educational software for personal and family learning. Use it only with appropriate adult supervision. Features, pricing and availability may change. Premium access is granted only after a payment is confirmed by the payment provider. Do not attempt to misuse, reverse engineer, overload, or interfere with the service or payment systems. Nothing in the app is a guarantee of educational outcomes.
about: Writing Kids is a lightweight handwriting practice app built around TRACE → COPY → WRITE, simple words, pronunciation, rewards and playful mini-games. The core learning experience is designed to remain useful offline and on slower devices.
disclaimer: Writing Kids is an educational practice tool, not a medical, therapeutic, diagnostic or professional educational service. Children may need teacher, parent or specialist support. Internet-dependent services such as push notifications and payments may be unavailable. Payment authorization, OTP and 3-D Secure steps are controlled by the payment provider and issuing bank.
